// diagnostic E2820

Jet.InvalidScreen

`.screen("{path}", …)` registers no screen: {found}.

What

`.screen("{path}", …)` registers no screen: {found}.

Why

A screen's state is its address: each of its fields is a `:field` segment of the path or, marked `#App.Query`, goes after `?`, and every target opens the screen from that address, so the state has one screen and each field a place in the address.

Fix

Write the path as a string literal starting with `/`, give the view one parameter besides its `app.Remote<S>` ones, a struct whose fields each derive `Encode` and `Decode`, make the view unable to fail and give a value that derives `Encode`, name each field that isn't `#App.Query` once as a `:field` segment, and register each state at one screen.

Worked example
